signatures.object: Weights of the Challenger (question generator) and Solver models, with a small anchor pool of human-labeled data as in-context grounding
signatures.information: 1-5% of WebInstruct labeled examples; Solver self-consistency success rates; pseudo-labels from majority vote
signatures.operation: GRPO-train the Challenger on a difficulty-shaped reward with repetition penalty; GRPO-train the Solver on curriculum-selected (mid-uncertainty) synthetic and human examples
signatures.output: Updated Challenger and Solver weights per iteration
signatures.feedback: Solver pass rates and answer agreement
signatures.selection_rule: Keep questions whose estimated success rate lies in [tau_low, tau_high]
signatures.selection_data: Solver rollouts on generated and human questions
signatures.claimed_effect: +3.0 math points over R-Zero at 8B; parity with General-Reasoner on 1-5% human data
